notes.title: [Patch 1.06] Glasshouse: Concept Demo
notes.notes:
Hello flatmates,

We've released a [b]patch[/b] that corrects many of the previously reported problems related to the [b]Concept Demo[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43329820/e4c90bfc077644177c4269ec6f7b76849d3cc441.png[/img]

Here's the [b]changelog for Patch 1.06[/b]: 

[list]
[*]     21:9 resolution is now supported
[*]     New "Controls Screen"
[*]     Updated Director's portrait
[*]     Updated CDB Vassal's portrait
[*]     Lighting improvement on Death Ending
[*]     Fixed missing "shot" SFX in the Showdown Scene
[*]     Various ENG translation fixes
[*]     Minor UI (inventory related) bug fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43329820/7c70ad045dc5de2fd4e259da244341f32660dcb5.png[/img]

Thank you for your time, see you soon!

[i]Giacomo Montagnoli, Creative Director
FLAT28 Collective[/i]
